recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the accepted FHIR-26883 source change without changing cardinality, target profiles, or binding strength; no generated diagram artifacts were edited.
issue_request: FHIR-26883 was an Applied/Persuasive CDS change request for FHIR-core RiskAssessment. The report identified missing valueSet targets on RiskAssessment example bindings, and the accepted resolution required example bindings for code, method, reason, and prediction.outcome.
initial_application: PR HL7/fhir#3369 was recorded on the Jira and its RiskAssessment commit 62c04424203f3ad49adb430c60369e446af78c00 added valueSet targets for method, code, and prediction.outcome, plus the supporting method/outcome terminology. That application did not add a binding to RiskAssessment.reason.
additional_context: RiskAssessment is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-38925 explains the overlapping outcome-specific part of PR #3369, while later FHIR-55077 renamed only the RiskAssessment method/outcome terminology canonicals to Example names. The Event pattern leaves Event.reason generically unbound, so adding an existing example condition-code binding to the RiskAssessment-specific reason element is a bounded resource-level completion of the accepted Jira resolution.
reconciliation: Updated source/riskassessment/structuredefinition-RiskAssessment.xml to add an example RiskAssessmentReason binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/condition-code, and removed the obsolete RiskAssessment.reason bindingExistence exception from source/riskassessment/riskassessment-event-mapping-exceptions.xml.
source_changes: source/riskassessment/structuredefinition-RiskAssessment.xml: added an example binding for RiskAssessment.reason to ValueSet/condition-code.
source/riskassessment/riskassessment-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: removed the stale bindingExistence exception for RiskAssessment.reason.
